candidate_fix.symptom: 1.0.2.24 scan retest reaches BC permission enforcement but fails with TableData 53100 DH Setup IndirectModify.
candidate_fix.root_cause: BCSENTINEL SCAN had direct read R on DH Setup but no lowercase indirect modify permission m. Codeunit Permissions properties alone cannot satisfy the user's indirect table permission requirement.
candidate_fix.implementation: Change BCSENTINEL SCAN DH Setup permission from R to Rm. Keep direct M absent. Authorized scan codeunits retain tabledata DH Setup = RM object permissions.
candidate_fix.security_invariant: SCAN can read DH Setup directly and modify it only indirectly through explicitly authorized BCSentinel codeunits; direct Setup modification remains denied.
